user.title: Kostal Piko
user.description: Connect to the web interface of your Kostal Piko inverter.

reconfigure.title: Kostal Piko
reconfigure.description: Change the address or login of the inverter. Sensors and history are kept.

reauth_confirm.title: Kostal Piko login
reauth_confirm.description: The inverter at {host} rejected the login. Enter the current username and password.

error.could_not_connect: Could not connect to the inverter. Check the host, username and password.
error.unsupported_device: This inverter is not supported: its web pages have an unknown structure. Open an issue at {issues_url} and attach the pages index.fhtml and Solar2.fhtml (remove the serial number first).

abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different inverter (serial number does not match).

init.title: Kostal Piko
init.description: How often the inverter is read. The inverter needs about 1 s per page, so values below 10 s make no sense. Choose the sensors that are created and how often they are updated.
